SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT LEGACY_PO_NO AS LEGACY_PO_NO FROM KEPPOHD WHERE 1=1 AND IF_FLAG = 'N' GROUP BY LEGACY_PO_NO
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'KBPO' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, NVL(PLANT,' ') AS PLANT, NVL(LEGACY_PO_NO,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_NO, NVL(LEGACY_PO_SEQ,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, NVL(STATUS,'D') AS STATUS, NVL(BUYER_ITEM_NO,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, NVL(UNIT_PRICE,0) AS UNIT_PRICE, NVL(ITEM_QTY,0) AS ITEM_QTY, NVL(ITEM_AMT,0) AS ITEM_AMT, NVL(ADD_DATE,' ') AS ADD_DATE, NVL(RD_DATE,' ') AS RD_DATE, NVL(DELY_TO_LOCATION,' ') AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, NVL(ZIP_CODE,' ') AS ZIP_CODE, NVL(ADDRESS_LOC,' ') AS ADDRESS_LOC, NVL(ZIP_CODE,' ')||' '||NVL(ADDRESS_LOC,' ') AS DELY_TO_LOCATION_TEXT, NVL(PURCHASER_USER_ID,' ') AS PURCHASER_USER_ID, NVL(REQ_USER_NAME,' ') AS REQ_USER_NAME, NVL(REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME,' ') AS REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME, NVL(REMARK,' ') AS REMARK FROM KEPPOHD WHERE 1=1 AND LEGACY_PO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY LEGACY_PO_NO,LEGACY_PO_SEQ
UPDATE KEPPOHD SET IF_FLAG = 'Y', IF_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), IF_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE 1=1 AND LEGACY_PO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
